name: clear_buffers_and_wait_blitter

name: run_conditional_object_updates

name: scan_control_byte_stream

name: call_object_handler_pointer

name: update_object_animation_state
description: When an object's enable field is set, stores a new handler pointer, computes two position fields from screen values, and calls routines for optional sub-updates. It then advances a frame counter and, when a timing difference exceeds two, toggles a state flag.

name: toggle_object_state_on_timer
description: When a timing difference exceeds two, updates the last-timing field, toggles a state word, and stores one of two pairs of values into the object's pointer fields and a global. It also touches the copper list pointer register.

name: add_bcd_digit_pairs
description: Adds four pairs of bytes into decimal-coded counter bytes, applying a decimal adjustment after each addition. It reads and writes the same structure and makes no calls.

name: call_single_routine_and_return

name: draw_masked_tiles_to_planes
description: Draws eight rows of tile data into four bitplanes, clearing masked bits and then OR-ing in the tile pattern for each plane. The routine runs for a count held in a register and is called by two other routines.

name: setup_blitter_copy_rows
description: Waits for the blitter to be free, then programs its control, modulo, first and last word mask, pointer and size registers for each pair of rows, decrementing a count until done. It is called by one other routine.

name: update_palette_and_interrupt_state
description: Reads the interrupt request state, bumps a frame counter, and copies eight longwords of colour data into the colour registers when the palette pointer is set. It also clamps a value to the range zero to 255 and calls one other routine.

name: init_four_audio_channels
description: Sets the period and volume registers on all four audio channels and points each channel at a shared one-word sample with length one. It waits on the audio interrupt request bits before writing.

name: update_position_from_direction_bits
description: Decodes direction bits from an input word and moves two signed position fields by one step, clamping them to a fixed range; when a flag is clear it applies a difference from a second input word instead. The routine also reads the fire-button port.

name: clip_scaled_span_to_screen
description: Computes scaled coordinates by dividing by a divisor, clips the span to the visible area at zero and at a width of 352, and returns early when nothing remains visible. It makes one call.

name: clip_scaled_span_then_draw
description: Computes the same scaled coordinates and clipping as its neighbour, then continues into a drawing step that calls one other routine while the span is still visible.

name: clip_and_blit_scaled_rows
description: Clips a row offset against a limit of 248 and returns when nothing is left, then programs the blitter control, modulo, pointer and size registers. It waits for the blitter to finish between writes.

name: program_blitter_for_row_copy
description: Waits for the blitter to be free, clears its shift and modulo registers, and then sets its pointers, size and a modulo value computed from two inputs. It makes no calls of its own.

name: program_blitter_fixed_control

name: clear_region_and_copy_rows
description: Zeroes a large region of memory word by word, then copies rows from a table into it and records each row's start pointer in a list. A further loop follows over sixteen entries.

name: build_scaled_row_table
description: Copies a header of two values from the input into object fields, computes a row stride from a width rounded up to sixteen, and fills an array of entries by dividing scaled coordinates by values from a table. The visible body makes no calls of its own.

name: step_counter_and_write_port
description: Advances a pair of byte counters and, when a carry occurs, steps a value toward a target, writing either the top bit or zero to a port location. It calls a routine three times and repeats those calls for a second counter when it is enabled.

name: decrement_timer_step_value

name: update_channel_state_and_output

name: clear_channel_state_bytes

name: parse_command_bytes_into_object

name: parse_command_bytes_and_dispatch

name: parse_command_bytes_and_dispatch

name: copy_block_then_jump

name: wait_port_and_get_message
